death.note: Stated as a reign and never recorded. This folder’s own life makes him the brother of Claudius and "a kinsman of the emperor Diocletian", exiled and burned at Ostia when "Diocletian learned that a whole family of his relatives had turned Christian". The interval is Diocletian’s reign, 284–305, which is the interval sixty-odd folders in this corpus already hold for that marker. No year, because the life gives none.
